metadata.name: sheaf
metadata.description: Sheaf: permissionless in-kind index baskets for tokenized equities on Solana, with an oracle-free Dutch-auction cash desk and recurring buy plans

instructions.name: cancel_order
docs: Cancel an order and refund its cash to the buyer. The buyer may cancel
at any time; after `end_ts` anyone may, as a clean-up crank. The refund
always goes to a cash account the buyer owns.

accounts.name: buyer_cash_account
docs: Any cash account the buyer owns; a stranger cannot redirect the refund.

instructions.name: close_legacy_plan
docs: Close a plan written by the pre-hardening release, whose account is
16 bytes shorter than today's `Plan` and so no longer decodes. Owner
only; revokes the allowance like `close_plan` and returns the rent.

accounts.name: plan
docs: field used are checked byte by byte in the handler.

accounts.name: owner_cash_account
docs: the handler); decoded leniently, as it may have been closed.

instructions.name: close_plan
docs: Close a plan. Revokes the plan's allowance on the owner's cash account
when it is still the delegate there; orders already placed by the plan
stay open and can still be filled or cancelled.

accounts.name: owner_cash_account
docs: closed, so it is decoded leniently in the handler.

instructions.name: create_basket
docs: Publish a basket recipe and take ownership of its share mint.
The share mint is created by the client (a Token-2022 mint carrying
on-chain metadata) with its mint authority already set to this basket's
PDA. We verify that here rather than trusting it.

instructions.name: fill_order
docs: Fill an open order: deliver the components, the buyer gets the shares,
the filler gets the cash. Permissionless.
The auction's current share count is what the buyer *receives*. The
filler delivers components for `gross` shares, the smallest count whose
creator fee (computed exactly as in `mint_shares`) leaves that much for
the buyer, and the creator receives `gross - received`.
`remaining_accounts` is the same as `mint_shares`, with the filler's
component accounts as the source.

accounts.name: buyer_share_account
docs: Shares can only land in the buyer's canonical share account.

accounts.name: creator_share_account
docs: (must be the basket creator) verified in the handler.

accounts.name: filler_cash_account
docs: Where the filler wants the cash. The filler signs, so it is theirs to pick.

accounts.name: plan
docs: and decoded in the handler (it may have been closed since).

instructions.name: mint_shares
docs: Deposit the recipe in kind and receive `shares` share tokens.
`remaining_accounts` is three per component, in basket order:
`[component_mint, depositor_token_account, basket_vault_ata]`.

accounts.name: creator_share_account
docs: (must be the basket creator) verified in the handler.

instructions.name: open_plan
docs: Open a recurring buy and delegate `cash_per_run * runs` of the owner's
cash account to the plan PDA, in one instruction.
`min_ref_shares_per_cash_e9` is the worst rate the owner will ever
accept: no run's auction ends below it, and the reference rate can
never be walked under it. `max_ref_shares_per_cash_e9` caps how far up
fills can push the reference. `min <= ref <= max`.

instructions.name: place_order
docs: Escrow `cash_amount` of a cash mint and post a Dutch auction for shares.
The number of shares the buyer must *receive* (net of the creator fee)
is `start_shares` until `start_ts`, decays linearly to `end_shares` at
`end_ts`, and the order cannot be filled after `end_ts`.

accounts.name: escrow
docs: The order PDA's own associated token account. `init_if_needed` so that
someone creating it first (it is a predictable address) cannot block
the order; the amount escrowed is measured as a balance delta.

instructions.name: redeem_shares
docs: Burn `shares` and take the underlying components back out, pro rata.
`remaining_accounts` is three per component, in basket order:
`[component_mint, basket_vault_ata, recipient_token_account]`.

instructions.name: run_plan
docs: Turn one slice of a plan into a desk order. Permissionless: whoever
cranks pays the order's rent and gets it back when the order closes.

instructions.name: update_plan
docs: Owner-only: re-centre a plan. Resets the reference rate, the band, the
auction length and the owner's rate bounds, under the same rules as
`open_plan`. This is how an owner un-sticks a plan the market has moved
away from, or tightens it after seeing a fill they did not like. The
schedule and the remaining allowance are untouched.

errors.name: NameTooLong
errors.msg: Basket name must be 1 to 32 characters

errors.name: SymbolTooLong
errors.msg: Basket symbol must be 1 to 10 characters

errors.name: CreatorFeeTooHigh
errors.msg: Creator fee cannot exceed 1%

errors.name: BadComponentCount
errors.msg: A basket holds between 1 and 8 components

errors.name: WeightsMustSumToOne
errors.msg: Component weights must add up to 100%

errors.name: DuplicateComponent
errors.msg: The same component was listed twice

errors.name: ZeroWeight
errors.msg: Every component needs a non-zero weight

errors.name: ZeroUnits
errors.msg: Every component needs a non-zero unit amount

errors.name: ShareMintDecimals
errors.msg: Share mint must have 6 decimals

errors.name: ShareMintNotEmpty
errors.msg: Share mint already has a supply

errors.name: ShareMintAuthority
errors.msg: Share mint authority must be the basket

errors.name: ShareMintFreezable
errors.msg: Share mint must not have a freeze authority

errors.name: ShareMintMismatch
errors.msg: Share mint does not match the basket

errors.name: WrongTokenProgram
errors.msg: Component lives on a different token program

errors.name: ComponentMintMismatch
errors.msg: Component mint does not match the basket recipe

errors.name: AccountCountMismatch
errors.msg: Wrong number of accounts for this basket

errors.name: VaultMismatch
errors.msg: Vault is not the basket's associated token account

errors.name: TokenAccountMintMismatch
errors.msg: Token account belongs to a different mint

errors.name: MalformedMint
errors.msg: Mint account data is malformed

errors.name: MalformedTokenAccount
errors.msg: Token account data is malformed

errors.name: MissingCreatorShareAccount
errors.msg: Creator share account is required when a creator fee is set

errors.name: ZeroShares
errors.msg: Share amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: DustMint
errors.msg: Share amount is too small to deposit against

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: CreatorShareAccountOwner
errors.msg: Creator fee shares must go to an account the basket creator owns

errors.name: ZeroCash
errors.msg: Cash amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: BadAuctionShares
errors.msg: Auction shares must satisfy start >= end > 0

errors.name: BadAuctionWindow
errors.msg: Auction window must satisfy start_ts < end_ts and end in the future

errors.name: OrderExpired
errors.msg: The auction has ended; the order can only be cancelled

errors.name: OrderNotExpired
errors.msg: Only the buyer can cancel before the auction ends

errors.name: OrderAccountMismatch
errors.msg: Account does not match the order

errors.name: MissingPlanAccount
errors.msg: This order came from a plan; pass the plan account

errors.name: PlanMismatch
errors.msg: Plan account does not match the order

errors.name: PlanAccountMismatch
errors.msg: Account does not match the plan

errors.name: BadPlanSchedule
errors.msg: Plan needs a positive period, run count and auction length

errors.name: BadReferenceRate
errors.msg: Reference rate must be greater than zero

errors.name: BandTooWide
errors.msg: Plan band cannot exceed 50%

errors.name: PlanAmountTooSmall
errors.msg: Cash per run is too small to buy a raw share unit at this rate

errors.name: PlanTooEarly
errors.msg: The next run of this plan is not due yet

errors.name: PlanExhausted
errors.msg: This plan has no runs left

errors.name: DelegateInUse
errors.msg: Cash account already delegates a live allowance to someone else

errors.name: ShareMintProgram
errors.msg: Share mint must be owned by the SPL Token or Token-2022 program

errors.name: ShareMintExtension
errors.msg: Share mint may carry metadata and no other extension

errors.name: ComponentMintExtension
errors.msg: Component mint carries an extension that could drain, pause or brick the vault

errors.name: CashMintExtension
errors.msg: Cash mint carries an extension that could seize, freeze or block escrowed cash

errors.name: EscrowShort
errors.msg: Escrow holds less than the order's cash

errors.name: BadReferenceBounds
errors.msg: Plan rate bounds must satisfy 0 < min <= reference <= max

errors.name: NotLegacyPlan
errors.msg: Not a pre-hardening plan account

errors.name: ComponentIssuerAuthority
errors.msg: Component mint gives a freeze, seize, pause or hook power to someone other than a known stock issuer

errors.name: CashMintAuthority
errors.msg: Cash mint lets someone other than a known issuer change its transfer fee or transfer hook

errors.name: ShareMintNotToken2022
errors.msg: Share mint must be a Token-2022 mint

fields.name: units_per_share
docs: Raw token units of this component backing one whole share.

fields.name: weight_bps
docs: Target weight at creation, recorded so drift is measurable later.

types.name: Order
docs: A cash order on the desk. PDA: `["order", basket, buyer, nonce_le]` for
`place_order`, `["plan_order", plan, nonce_le]` for `run_plan` (orders a
plan placed before the hardening release used the first form).
Its escrow is the order PDA's associated token account for `cash_mint`.

fields.name: buyer
docs: Receives the shares (in their canonical share ATA) and any refund.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Paid the order's and escrow's rent; gets it back when the order closes.
The buyer for `place_order`, the cranker for `run_plan`.

fields.name: plan
docs: The plan that placed this order, if any.

fields.name: cash_amount
docs: Cash actually received into escrow (net of any Token-2022 transfer fee).

fields.name: start_shares
docs: Shares the buyer receives, net of the creator fee, at `start_ts`.

fields.name: end_shares
docs: Shares the buyer receives at `end_ts`: the buyer's floor.

fields.name: shares
docs: Shares the buyer received.

fields.name: creator_fee_shares
docs: Shares the creator received on top; the filler delivered for both.

fields.name: cash
docs: Cash the order escrowed.

fields.name: cash_paid
docs: Cash that left escrow to the filler (`cash` plus anything donated).

fields.name: price
docs: Raw cash units per whole share the buyer received, rounded down.

fields.name: plan_ref_shares_per_cash_e9
docs: The plan's new reference rate, when this fill updated one.

types.name: Plan
docs: A recurring buy. PDA: `["plan", basket, owner, plan_id_le]`. It is the SPL
delegate of `cash_account` for the remaining allowance.

fields.name: ref_shares_per_cash_e9
docs: Raw share units per raw cash unit, times 10^9. Follows every fill.

fields.name: min_ref_shares_per_cash_e9
docs: The worst rate the owner accepts: no run's auction ends below
`cash × min / 10^9` shares, and fills never move the reference under it.

fields.name: max_ref_shares_per_cash_e9
docs: Fills never move the reference above this.

fields.name: run
docs: 1-based index of this run.
